testedVersions: .NET 11; Microsoft Graph REST v1.0 synthetic HTTP fixtures only
prerequisites: A Clarity Graph connection for this producer on the tenant (multi-tenant collector app with per-customer admin consent)
Admin consent for the section application permissions listed below
Organization.Read.All to verify the observed tenant before collecting any section
limits: Synthetic HTTP tests do not certify a live tenant or Key Vault access
Graph consent does not authorize SharePoint Online Management Shell or PnP.PowerShell
Drive metadata only; no file contents, permissions or sharing
Public Graph cloud only; tenant-wide scope; bounded ZIP v1 package sizes

testedVersions: Pester 5.7.1 with mocked Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell cmdlets; no live module version is certified
prerequisites: Windows PowerShell 5.1 on an authorized Windows workstation
Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell installed separately by an administrator
SharePoint administrator account signing in interactively to the tenant admin URL typed at launch
limits: Tenant binding is checked through the public OpenID configuration of the admin URL's onmicrosoft.com name
Personal sites are keyed by provisional normalized URL, never equated to Graph site IDs automatically
Storage values are the module's megabyte integers, not bytes

producers.apiVersion: Microsoft Graph v1.0 usage report CSV
testedVersions: Synthetic CSV fixtures of the documented Graph v1.0 getOneDriveUsageAccountDetail column set (byte units), with and without Site Id
prerequisites: Consultant upload of a report downloaded with Reports.Read.All and a Microsoft 365 reports role; tenant attested by the consultant
Or a server download through the tenant's clarity.graph.onedrive connection with Reports.Read.All (application); tenant observed
limits: Interpreted only through report profile m365.oneDriveUsageAccountDetail 1.0.0, whether uploaded or downloaded
Admin center MB exports, localized headers and multi-geo files are rejected

permissions: Files.Read.All or Sites.Read.All (application); Clarity reads drive metadata only
sections.refreshStrategy: Full user snapshot per run; one drives read per user
limits: Users without a readable OneDrive are counted as OneDriveNotProvisioned; Graph does not distinguish never-provisioned from inaccessible
Drives without sharepointIds.siteId are counted as SiteIdUnavailable and not converted
At most 20,000 users per run; larger tenants are Partial

sections.refreshStrategy: Full personal site snapshot per run
limits: Objects use the provisional namespace sharepoint.siteUrl plus an alternate url key; association with Graph site IDs is a reviewable proposal
Empty owners are counted as OwnerUnresolved and non-UPN (masked) owners as OwnerMasked; neither is guessed
Megabyte storage integers are rounded by the module

permissions: Reports.Read.All (delegated or application) to download the report; delegated users also need a Microsoft 365 reports role
endpoints: Consultant upload of GET /v1.0/reports/getOneDriveUsageAccountDetail(period='D7|D30|D90|D180') or (date=YYYY-MM-DD) CSV
Server download of GET /v1.0/reports/getOneDriveUsageAccountDetail(period='D30') through the clarity.graph.onedrive connection (302 to a pre-authenticated CSV URL)
sections.refreshStrategy: Report snapshot observed at the report refresh date
limits: Not a tenant-wide exhaustive OneDrive inventory; absence from a report never proves deletion
Concealed names and URLs are not converted or guessed
Without a Site Id column, OneDrive keys are provisional report URL references
